# Navikka (Marine Safety Navigator)
> Intelligent, real-time marine safety navigation application for Finland (and surrounding Baltic waters), built with Flutter, Riverpod, Drift (SQLite), and flutter_map.

## Problem Statement
Boaters and mariners navigating Finnish waters face fragmented data across multiple official systems (FMI weather & sea warnings, SYKE algae & water quality, Väylävirasto fairway & navigation aids, Traficom speed limits, MET Norway forecasts). Existing apps lack unified offline caching, real-time safety warnings, and responsive spatial data layers tailored for night and marine glove usage.

## Solution Architecture
Navikka unifies these disparate marine APIs into a single, high-performance offline-capable navigation app.
- **Frontend / UI**: Flutter 3.44+ with custom OLED dark-mode palette ("Night Captain" aesthetic), responsive typography (`clamp()`), and high-contrast tactile map controls.
- **State Management**: `flutter_riverpod` (v3.3+) using pure code-generated `@riverpod` Notifiers and `AsyncNotifier` streams.
- **Map & Spatial Layer**: `flutter_map` (v8.3+) with native tile caching, custom `RepaintBoundary` rendering layers, and EPSG:3067 (ETRS89 / TM35FIN) <-> EPSG:4326 (WGS84) coordinate transformations via `proj4dart` and `mgrs_dart`.
- **Local Persistence & Caching**: Drift (SQLite v18) with strict repository abstraction and `fpdart` `Either<Failure, T>` return signatures.
- **Earth Observation**: ESA Copernicus Sentinel-2 10m optical imagery and FMI / EUMETSAT 15-min weather satellite loops.
- **Sensors & On-Device AI**: `sensors_plus` IMU sensor fusion (accelerometer/gyroscope) for wave slamming & roughness estimation, Web Speech API for voice copilot, and Chrome Built-in AI / local marine reasoners.
- **Remote Integration**: `dio` + `json_serializable` for API fetchers (FMI WFS/OData, SYKE OData, OpenWeather, MET Norway), routed through a Cloudflare Worker CORS proxy for web deployment.

## Core Directory Map
- `lib/core/`: Shared utilities, themes, dependency injection, and spatial projection helpers.
- `lib/features/`: Feature-First modules (`ai`, `ais`, `contribution`, `fishing`, `harbors`, `map`, `menu`, `navigation`, `navigation_aids`, `satellite`, `speed_limits`, `tracking`, `vessel`, `weather`).
- `lib/main.dart`: App entry point and global Riverpod container initialization.
- `docs/`: User guide (`user_guide.md`), developer guide (`developer_guide.md`), deployment guide (`deployment_guide.md`), feature catalog (`features.md`), architecture (`architecture.md`), external APIs (`external_apis.md`), and ADR decisions (`decisions/`).
- `cloudflare-worker/`: Serverless CORS proxy for external API request proxying and server-side key management.
- `e2e/`: Playwright end-to-end web test suite.
- `.agent/`: Agent workflows, skills, rules, and prompt engineering instructions.

## Key Rules & Guidelines for AI Agents
1. **Feature-First Clean Architecture**: Each feature MUST reside in `lib/features/<name>/{data, domain, presentation}`.
2. **DTO Layer Isolation**: DTO models in `data/models/` MUST NOT import domain entities from `domain/entities/`.
3. **State Management**: Pure `@riverpod` annotations only. No legacy `StateProvider` or `ChangeNotifier`.
4. **Error Handling**: Data layers MUST return `Future<Either<Failure, T>>` using `fpdart`. Never leak raw exceptions to presentation.
5. **Static Analysis & Testing**: Code must pass `dart analyze lib/ test/` with 0 errors/warnings and pass `flutter test`.

## Command Quickstart
- Run App: `flutter run`
- Code Generation: `dart run build_runner build --delete-conflicting-outputs`
- Run Tests: `flutter test`
- Run Static Analysis: `dart analyze lib/ test/`
- Run Architecture Checks: `dart run scripts/architecture_check.dart`
- Format Code: `dart format .`
